_comment: Configuration for scripts/check-links.mjs. Entries here are known, deliberate exceptions. Shrink this file over time - every entry is a real to-do.

_ignoreFilesWhy.assets/footer.html: HTML partial injected into pages/* by assets/footer-loader.js. Its relative links resolve against the including page, not against assets/, so static resolution reports false positives.

_allowMissingWhy.images/team/*: Team member headshots that were never added to the repo. The profile pages fall back to initials, so the page still renders. Supply the photos to close these out.
_allowMissingWhy.*/vendor/boxicons.min.css: Optional self-hosted fallback for the Boxicons font, which is also loaded from a CDN in the same pages. The vendor copy was never committed.
